name: Endota Spa Mornington
signature: The Mornington town-centre day spa, reliable treatments, sensible pricing, and the sixty-minute option that fits before lunch on Main Street.
editorNote:
Endota Mornington is the chain's bayside outpost, and for visitors working a Mornington town-centre weekend it is the most practical day-spa option on that end of the Peninsula. The treatment menu covers the endota branded skincare staples, targeted massage, facials, and couples rooms, and the real value is location: a short walk from Main Street restaurants, the farmers market, and the bayside foreshore.

This is not the spa to book if you want a full thermal bathing experience, a resort-style circuit, or a wellness retreat. Those live at Peninsula Hot Springs, Alba Thermal Springs, and One Spa at RACV Cape Schanck respectively. Endota Mornington is the sixty-to-ninety-minute treatment that makes a Mornington weekend feel more complete without committing a full half-day to wellness.

The best pairing: Mornington Farmers Market on a Wednesday morning, a massage at Endota around midday, then a long lunch on Main Street. For anniversary weekends at a Mornington bayside hotel, a couples treatment here is the most practical wellness move, no drive, no parking, no restaurant time lost. Book two to three weeks out for a weekend treatment.
whyWeGo: The spa that works as part of a Mornington morning, close enough to Main Street that you can walk from the treatment table to a lunch reservation.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book two to three weeks out for a weekend treatment and pair it with a long lunch on Main Street.
